data.name: AlJaleelah
data.gender_notes: AlJaleelah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Al-Jalil', meaning 'the elevated one', 'the great one', 'the mighty one'. This name carries a sense of grandeur, nobility, and strength, reflecting the qualities of powerful and revered figures in Islamic history. The name AlJaleelah carries the meaning “The Elevated One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlJaleelah usually hope their child will grow to embody the elevated one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a deep connection to the divine, representing a humble and reverent attitude towards God.
data.etymology: AlJaleelah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Elevated One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlJaleelah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: الجلالة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الجلال و العظمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الجلالة هو اسم علم مؤنث يوحي بالعظمة و الجلال، و هو مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'ج-ل-ل' الذي يعني العلو و الرفعة. و في القرآن الكريم، نجد أن للجلال و العظمة معاني روحية و أخلاقية عالية، مما يجعل الاسم ذا قيمة دينية و أخلاقية كبيرة في التقاليد الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: الجلالة
in_urdu.long_meaning: الجلالة ایک علم اسم ہے جو عظمت و جلال سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا لغوی جذر 'ج-ل-ل' ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بلند و بالا۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، یہ نام روحانی و اخلاقی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان، جہاں یہ عظمت و بزرگی کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलजलाला
in_hindi.meaning: महानता और गरिमा से लिया गया
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलजलाला एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो महानता और गरिमा से लिया गया है। इसका मूल 'ज-ल-ल' है जिसका अर्थ है उच्च और उत्कृष्ट। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और नैतिक महत्व रखता है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में गरिमा और सम्मान की भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: الجلاله
in_pashto.meaning: د عظمت او جلال څخه مشتق شوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: الجلاله د ښځینه اسم دی چی د عظمت او جلال څخه اخیستل شوی دی. ددی لغوی ریشه 'ج-ل-ل' دی چی معنی یی لوړ او برتر دی. په پښتنو او افغانانو کی، دی نوم ديني او کلتوري ارزښت لري، او د سولې، عزت او وقار نښه ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: AlJaleelah
in_english.long_meaning: AlJaleelah is a feminine name derived from the Arabic root 'ج-ل-ل' (j-l-l), implying grandeur, majesty, and sublimity. In Islamic tradition, the name conveys spiritual and moral significance, reflecting attributes of elevation and nobility. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing dignity and respect.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'AlJaleelah' holds significant cultural value in the Islamic community as it signifies the elevated and exalted status of individuals who bear this name. It carries an air of prestige, nobility, and respect, often associated with Islamic historical figures and scholars whose accomplishments and contributions to the community have left a lasting impact. In modern times, this name is often given as a means to inspire and instill a sense of greatness, ambition, and strength within the bearer.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'AlJaleelah' is believed to carry the blessings and divine guidance of Allah (SWT). The name is a reminder of the greatness and power of Allah and the insignificance of worldly matters in comparison to the eternal and spiritual journey of life. It serves as an inspiration for individuals to strive to emulate the qualities of AlJaleelah - humility, noble character, strength, and seeking of knowledge and wisdom - in their daily lives, thus drawing closer to Allah and earning His pleasure and blessings.
